the molecular mechanisms of the 2μm plasmid, a selfish genetic element that is stably maintained in the nucleus of the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
the mechanisms by which the 2-mu plasmid maintains itself as a selfish element in the yeast nucleus, by regulating the activities of the Flp recombinase.
